# fabricext_lakehouse_permission (Resource)

!> **Warning:** **Experimental Provider**: The `fabricext` provider is published in a pre-`v1.0.0` experimental state to facilitate automated packaging and supply-chain verification. For core workspace and item management, use the official Microsoft [`microsoft/fabric`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/microsoft/fabric/latest) provider.

~> **Note:** Item-level permission resources call internal Power BI service endpoints because Microsoft Fabric does not yet offer a v1 REST write API for item sharing. Endpoint behavior may change without notice; pin provider versions and validate upgrades in non-production workspaces first.

~> **Note:** For end-to-end guidance and real-world multi-persona security configurations, see the [Access Control Playbook](../guides/access_control_playbook.md).

Manages direct item-level permissions on a Microsoft Fabric **Lakehouse** for Microsoft Entra users, groups, service principals, or managed identities.

~> **Note:** Manages item-level sharing permissions on a Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse for Microsoft Entra principals via the underlying Power BI metadata service. For storage-level table, folder, RLS, and CLS access control, use `fabricext_lakehouse_data_access_role`.

## Drift Detection and Convergence

The provider performs stateful drift detection during refresh. Out-of-band permission grants, upgrades, or downgrades are detected and converged in place on subsequent apply. When configured using item identifiers, display name renames upstream do not force replacement. If the underlying item is deleted upstream, refresh cleanly drops the resource from state to plan recreation.

## Example Usage
```terraform
# Grant direct item-level sharing permissions on a Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse
resource "fabricext_lakehouse_permission" "curated_analysts" {
  workspace_id   = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  lakehouse_name = "curated_lakehouse"
  principal_id   = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  principal_type = "Group"
  permissions    = ["Read", "ReadData"]
}

# Grant direct permissions by Lakehouse UUID (recommended for rename immunity)
resource "fabricext_lakehouse_permission" "pipeline_service_principal" {
  workspace_id   = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  lakehouse_id   = "44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444444"
  principal_id   = "55555555-5555-5555-5555-555555555555"
  principal_type = "ServicePrincipal"
  permissions    = ["Read", "ReadData", "ReadAll", "Reshare"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (Set of String) Set of item permissions granted to the principal. Must include `Read`. Valid permissions for Lakehouse are `Read`, `ReadData`, `ReadAll`, `Reshare`, and `Execute`.
- `principal_id` (String) Microsoft Entra Object ID (UUID) of the user, group, service principal, or managed identity.
- `principal_type` (String) Type of Microsoft Entra principal (`User`, `Group`, `ServicePrincipal`, `ManagedIdentity`).
- `workspace_id` (String) UUID of the Microsoft Fabric workspace containing the Lakehouse.

### Optional

- `lakehouse_id` (String) Resolved or explicitly specified UUID of the Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse. At least one of `lakehouse_name` or `lakehouse_id` must be specified.
- `lakehouse_name` (String) Display name of the target Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse. At least one of `lakehouse_name` or `lakehouse_id` must be specified.
- `message` (String) Custom email notification message sent when `notify` is set to `true`. Requires `notify = true`.
- `notify` (Boolean) Whether to send an email notification when granting or updating item permissions. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `{workspace_id}/{lakehouse_id}/{principal_type}/{principal_id}`.
## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
# Import an existing Lakehouse item-level permission using {workspace_id}/{lakehouse_id}/{principal_type}/{principal_id}
terraform import fabricext_lakehouse_permission.curated_analysts "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444444/Group/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
```
